verdict.rationale: Google Workspace supports background automation via Apps Script (which can run scheduled/triggered scripts to automate Admin console and other tasks) and auto-provisioning workflows that sync changes automatically, plus emerging Gemini AI assistant features in Gmail. However, evidence is thin generic doc blurbs rather than detailed documentation of autonomous, AI-driven background agents, and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of this working as a true 'AI-native' automation layer. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of trigger-based/scheduled Apps Script automation, evidence of AI agents autonomously orchestrating multi-step workflows, and independent corroboration of reliability.
